titulo: Deep Dive Recap: Gender perspectives in Education, Training, Exercises and Evaluation and Professional Military Education
descricao: On the 15th of January, the Office of the Gender Advisor (GENAD) convened its first Deep Dive of the year, on the topic of Gender Perspectives and the Women, Peace and Security (WPS) Agenda in Education, Training, Exercises and Evaluation (ETEE) and Professional Military Education (PME).

titulo: NATO hosts senior communications officials from across the Alliance
descricao: On Thursday and Friday (7-8 May 2026), NATO hosted a meeting of senior communications officials from across the Alliance at NATO Headquarters in Brussels.

titulo: The Chairs of the NATO Military Committee and of the EU Military Committee reaffirm strong commitment to regional stability in a joint visit to the Western Balkans
descricao: The Chair of the NATO Military Committee (CMC), Admiral Giuseppe Cavo Dragone, and the Chair of the EU Military Committee (CEUMC), General Seán Clancy, conducted a joint visit to Pristina and Sarajevo, on 28 and 29 April 2026. The visit highlighted NATO-EU shared commitment to stability in the Western Balkans region.

On 27 April 2026, the NATO Military Committee (MC), with its Chair, Admiral Giuseppe Cavo Dragone, visited the NATO-led Kosovo Force (KFOR). The visit to Camp Film City in Pristina focused on KFOR's continued contributions to maintain a safe and secure environment for all people living in Kosovo.
